name: 14020 · Batavia, NY
findings: ZIP 14020 (Batavia) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14020 (Batavia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14020 (Batavia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
